references.text: The daughters of Zelophehad are mentioned here, those who married within the tribe of Manasseh
The daughters of Zelophehad presented their case regarding inheritance rights, which is the background for the marriage rule followed in Num 36:12
The tribe of Manasseh raises concern that the inheritance will be lost if the daughters marry outside the tribe
The names of the daughters of Zelophehad who married their cousins from the tribe of Manasseh
The daughters of Zelophehad receive their inheritance in the tribe of Manasseh as promised
Manasseh, son of Joseph, is mentioned, and his tribe's right to an inheritance is established
